semantic_content.answer: For x ≠ 2, (x² − 4)/(x − 2) = x + 2. The original expression has domain ℝ \ {2}. The simplified expression x + 2 is defined at x = 2, whereas the original is not, so they are not equivalent at every real number; they agree exactly on ℝ \ {2}.
